The public case for certification exists but is weak. But the admissible record also directly undermines a no-disclosure posture: the affected segment is below target, is named in a regulated-customer pilot order form, legal review is unresolved, and policy says named launch use case limitations must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance.
